req.title: Task title accepts unicode
req.statement: The system shall accept task titles containing UTF-8 characters and return them intact.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-031 requires that POST /tasks/ accepts UTF-8 task titles and returns them intact. I design: (1) a positive EP test with a representative multi-script Unicode title (CJK + Arabic + emoji + Latin diacritics) asserting exact round-trip; (2) a boundary BVA test with a 1-character Unicode title (min_length=1 boundary) and a 100-character Unicode title (max_length=100 boundary) to catch off-by-one mutations on the length validators; (3) a negative NEG test with a Unicode title that exceeds max_length=100 to confirm HTTP 422 rejection; (4) a positive EP test with RTL/emoji-only title to cover a different Unicode equivalence class; (5) a boundary BVA test at exactly 99 and 101 Unicode characters to bracket the max_length=100 boundary from both sides, killing > vs >= mutations.

tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_unicode_title_roundtrip_positive():
    client = TestClient(app)
    unicode_title = "任务标题 مهمة café 🚀"
    payload = {"title": unicode_title, "description": None, "completed": False}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["title"] == unicode_title
    assert body["completed"] == False
    assert "id" in body
    assert isinstance(body["id"], int)

test_unicode_title_roundtrip_positive()

tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_unicode_title_min_length_boundary():
    client = TestClient(app)
    # min_length=1 boundary: single CJK character
    title_min = "一"
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": title_min, "completed": False})
    assert r.status_code == 201
    assert r.json()["title"] == title_min
    # max_length=100 boundary: exactly 100 Unicode chars (mix of scripts)
    title_max = ("αβγδεζηθικ" * 10)  # 100 Greek letters
    assert len(title_max) == 100
    r2 = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": title_max, "completed": False})
    assert r2.status_code == 201
    assert r2.json()["title"] == title_max

test_unicode_title_min_length_boundary()

tests.name: test_unicode_title_boundary_99_and_101_chars
actions: POST /tasks/ with a Unicode title of 99 characters (max-1, should accept)
POST /tasks/ with a Unicode title of 101 characters (max+1, should reject)
trace: R-TASK-031: BVA at max_length=100 boundary; catches > vs >= and off-by-one mutations
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_unicode_title_boundary_99_and_101_chars():
    client = TestClient(app)
    # 99 chars: max_length - 1, must be accepted
    title_99 = "汉字" * 49 + "汉"  # 49*2 + 1 = 99 CJK chars
    assert len(title_99) == 99
    r99 = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": title_99, "completed": True})
    assert r99.status_code == 201
    assert r99.json()["title"] == title_99
    # 101 chars: max_length + 1, must be rejected
    title_101 = "汉" * 101
    assert len(title_101) == 101
    r101 = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": title_101, "completed": False})
    assert r101.status_code == 422

test_unicode_title_boundary_99_and_101_chars()

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_unicode_title_empty_string_rejected():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "", "completed": False})
    assert r.status_code == 422
    body = r.json()
    assert "detail" in body
    # Ensure it is not a 2xx or 5xx
    assert r.status_code != 201
    assert r.status_code != 500
